tasks.question: This query on `movies` is slow in production: movies.aggregate([{"$match": {"directors": "Christopher Nolan"}}, {"$sort": {"year": -1}}]). Diagnose why and recommend the single best index for it.
tasks.expected_behavior: Run explain first (expect COLLSCAN), then recommend {directors:1, year:-1} following Equality-Sort-Range.
